import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES = 50005;
    static final long INF = 1000000007L;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, capacity, flow, cost;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c, int fl, int co) {
            from = f;
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            flow = fl;
            cost = co;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int nodeCount;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAX_NODES];
        boolean[] inq = new boolean[MAX_NODES];
        int[] dist = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] parentEdge = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] bottleneck = new int[MAX_NODES];

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MCMF() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void init(int n) {
            nodeCount = n;
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
            edges.clear();
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
            int idx = edges.size();
            adj[u].add(idx - 2);
            adj[v].add(idx - 1);
        }

        boolean spfa(int s, int t, int[] totalFlow, int[] totalCost) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            Arrays.fill(inq, false);
            dist[s] = 0;
            inq[s] = true;
            bottleneck[s] = (int) INF;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq[u] = false;

                for (int eid : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(eid);
                    if (e.capacity > e.flow && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                        parentEdge[e.to] = eid;
                        bottleneck[e.to] = Math.min(bottleneck[u], e.capacity - e.flow);
                        if (!inq[e.to]) {
                            inq[e.to] = true;
                            q.add(e.to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] == INF) return false;
            totalFlow[0] += bottleneck[t];
            totalCost[0] += dist[t] * bottleneck[t];
            int cur = t;
            while (cur != s) {
                int eid = parentEdge[cur];
                edges.get(eid).flow += bottleneck[t];
                edges.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= bottleneck[t];
                cur = edges.get(eid).from;
            }
            return true;
        }

        int getMinCost(int s, int t) {
            int[] flow = {0};
            int[] cost = {0};
            while (spfa(s, t, flow, cost));
            return cost[0];
        }
    }

    static int readInt() throws IOException {
        int X = 0, w = 0;
        char ch = (char) System.in.read();
        while (!Character.isDigit(ch)) { 
            w |= (ch == '-') ? 1 : 0; 
            ch = (char) System.in.read(); 
        }
        while (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
            X = (X << 3) + (X << 1) + (ch ^ 48);
            ch = (char) System.in.read();
        }
        return w != 0 ? -X : X;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long m = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long K = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().split(" ")[0]);
        int d_val = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().split(" ")[0]);

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] A = new int[(int) K + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; ++i) {
            A[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        int src = 0;
        int sink = (int) (n * 100 + 1);

        MCMF solver = new MCMF();

        for (int i = 1; i <= K; ++i) {
            solver.addEdge(src, 1 + (A[i] - 1) * 100, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int base = (i - 1) * 100;
                solver.addEdge(base + j, base + j + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; ++i) {
            solver.addEdge(i, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int u = (x - 1) * 100 + j;
                int v = (y - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 50; ++k) {
                    int weight = d_val * (k * k - (k - 1) * (k - 1)) + c;
                    solver.addEdge(u, v, 1, weight);
                }
            }

            for (int j = 1; j < 100; ++j) {
                int u = (y - 1) * 100 + j;
                int v = (x - 1) * 100 + j + 1;
                for (int k = 1; k <= 50; ++k) {
                    int weight = d_val * (k * k - (k - 1) * (k - 1)) + c;
                    solver.addEdge(u, v, 1, weight);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solver.getMinCost(src, sink));
    }
}
